# KONOV

> KONOV is Africa's first AI & ML literacy hub for kids ages 6–16, teaching how intelligent systems think through hands-on workshops, tech camps, and the MeAI learning app in Ghana.

KONOV builds practical AI and Machine Learning education for young African learners. Programs combine in-person workshops, a summer tech camp, community tech fairs, the MeAI ed-tech app, and the FORGE project studio where teens build real AI projects.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of KONOV's mission, programs, and impact.
- [About](/about): Founder story, mission, values, and team behind KONOV.

- [Resources](/resources): Interactive AI learning resources and links to the MeAI app.
- [Waitlist](/waitlist): Join the waitlist for upcoming programs and MeAI access.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the KONOV team.
